morbi.headline: Morbi cluster shows premium-led recovery amidst export volume contraction and fraud risks.
what_changed: Varmora Granito reported H1 profit surge driven by premium tile margins, indicating sector recovery for larger players.
Indian ceramic tile exports experienced a steep 46% volume drop during April-July 2026 with a weak FY27 outlook.
A Morbi tile manufacturer faced a credit fraud incident involving a Mumbai buyer defaulting on Rs 44.74 lakh.
stress_signals: Export volume drop of 46% between April and Jul 2026 threatens export-reliant MSMEs [434975bd08e0].
Liquidity and counterparty risk highlighted by a Rs 44.74 lakh credit fraud involving a vanished buyer [29ed75c6450d].
improvement_signals: Varmora Granito financial results and 498% H1 profit jump point to recovery driven by premium tiles [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c].
what_to_watch: Whether recovery indicators extend from large branded players to smaller MSME vitrified and wall tile producers.
Export volume trends and overseas demand recovery for the remainder of FY27.
Counterparty credit checks, receivables management, and buyer verification protocols for outstation orders.

surat.headline: Surat faces severe operational and cost shocks in textiles alongside weak diamond exports.
what_changed: Textile looms face a month-long shutdown due to a 50% spike in raw material costs, while power cuts and labour protests escalate.
The embroidery sub-segment remains crippled by an ongoing three-month labour dispute over wages and working conditions.
Textile units are diversifying into defence technical textiles, and diamond testing capacity expands via ICA-GemLab.
stress_signals: 50% raw material cost spike causes a Diwali slump and planned month-long loom shutdown affecting 75,000 workers [48c63a4e50b6].
Persistent three-month labour dispute and protests over wages, working hours, and holidays disrupt embroidery job-work units [8a31a5a2c20c, 442c4ff911f8, a57d83616799, 7697e96a190e, e7921383cbb7].
Eight-hour power cuts cause severe operational disruptions across continuous-operation processing and weaving units [167f80ff6cdc, 5ae803461fe0].
Polished diamond shipments slump, driving a 7% drop in Surat diamond exports amid localized payment default reports [975918f112f3, 698c779932f2].
improvement_signals: GST Council grants Input Tax Credit (ITC) refunds and eases highway checks for textile units [17f0a015a73c].
Textile manufacturers commence production of advanced defence fabrics for the Indian Army, expanding into technical textiles [4966bee026d8, 0f163b499572].
ICA-GemLab to set up its first Indian laboratory in Surat for diamond and gemstone testing [26bd1ecd549c].
what_to_watch: Details and timelines for the upcoming new textile policy and national policy formulation [7cb0d1c51743, a3db8ea1103a].
Resolution of the embroidery labor dispute to assess machine-loan debt service and cash-flow recovery in job-work units.
Power availability and operational continuity in continuous-process loom sheds and processing houses.
Account-level working capital utilization and overdues among small embroidery and loom operators during the month-long shutdown.
